payload.title: Release v0.11.0 and pin the claim-check CLI to it
payload.body: After the owner's trust setup (land-0-10-3-version-bump-and-claim-check-cli-pin) is done, follow docs/release-and-ci.md 'Autonomous release' to publish v0.11.0 (package.json is already 0.11.0). Then change CLI_VERSION in .github/workflows/tasks-claim-check.yml from 0.10.0 to 0.11.0 in a PR with Task/Task-Claim trailers. Verify: curl -s https://registry.npmjs.org/@tasks-md/cli | jq -r '."dist-tags".latest' prints 0.11.0.
